messages:
tess: Heads-up: spotted cases where the endpoint detail shows p50 > p95 for the same minute on a few routes (notably /v1/completions). Looks like users are getting confused in the console.

miguel: Oof. That's a red flag for trust. Do we have a concrete minute and numbers?

tess: 2025-02-03T11:12Z: detail p50=420ms, overview p95=390ms for same 1m bucket.

harry: Two usual suspects: (A) different sample sources (ingress vs post-routing merged), (B) tdigest vs histogram/sketch differences + rounding/quantization.

miguel: I traced it: detail tile was reading histogram_shards (edge proxy) while overview pulls tdigest_merged (post-routing). Merge job had a ~35s delay for that minute so the merged row lacked the short-lived heavy tail that sat in the proxy histogram.

tess: So asynchronous merge + different sources. UX problem.

zoe: Proposal: make the source explicit on every quantile tile and add a tenant-level default. Defaults: console-default = "canonical_post_routing" (for SLOs), dev-default = "ingress_early_detect" (opt-in).

miguel: +1. Also add an API param for internal tools: metrics?source=post_routing|ingress|all. Keeps tooling reproducible.

harry: Backend changes: the metrics proxy can select table at request time. We'll add counts_by_origin in the response (ingress/routed/retry) and a sample_origin histogram. Minimal change: map source param to table and include counts.

zoe: UX: badge on tile "Source: post-routing" with hover explaining merge latency and what is authoritative for SLOs. Add small legend styles: solid blue = canonical, dashed orange = ingress.

miguel: We should also guard against inversion programmatically: add a monotonicity check in our metrics lib for same-source queries (if p50>p95, log a high-severity diagnostic and attach raw sample counts). Don't auto-fail alerts, just file a ticket for telemetry team.

harry: Also important: tdigest compression can slightly mis-rank percentiles when sample counts are tiny. We'll add a warning when sample_count < 50: "small N: quantiles approximate".

tess: Good. For rollout UX: canary dashboards should default to ingress to surface early regressions. Production SLO dashboards default to post-routing. Add tenant flag `console.quantile_source_preference`.

zoe: Tests: frontend unit + e2e that toggles source and asserts badge and legend update. Backend unit tests for metrics proxy param and counts_by_origin. Integration: create synthetic traffic that emits a short 1m tail only at ingress and ensure toggling shows expected inversion and the explain modal reveals counts_by_origin.

miguel: Ops: add runbook blurb for oncall: "If overview != detail: check tile source, check counts_by_origin. If ingress > 10% of samples, expect earlier bump. If sample_count < 50, expect approximation noise."

harry: Dev note: adding the source param may affect our cache keys. We'll namespace caches by source to avoid stale reads. Also TTL for merged rows is currently 90s; consider lowering to 20s for high-traffic routes (configurable).

devops-bot: PRs opened: console UI changes https://git.redwood/console/pulls/3782 (adds source selector, badge, legend); infra metrics proxy https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/9333 (adds source param + counts_by_origin + cache namespacing).

zoe: Copy for tooltip suggestion:
"Source: post-routing (default). Post-routing = tdigest-merged signal used for SLOs; may lag by ~30-60s due to merge latency. Switch to ingress for earlier, noisier detection. See counts_by_origin for breakdown"

miguel: I'll add API docs update and a note in the metrics changelog.

tess: Nice. Once merged, let's ship a short notice in #product about the default behavior so PMs know the SLO dashboards remain authoritative.

harry: Follow-ups assigned: infra (miguel) to land proxy change; frontend (zoe) to land UI + tests; telemetry (harry) to add monotonicity logger & small-N warning.

tess: Thanks team. Hoping this reduces the "dashboard mistrust" tickets. :rocket:
